task: Open the ASCII point cloud /home/user/Documents/survey.xyz in CloudCompare. Create a binary little-endian PLY representation of this point cloud and save it to: /home/user/Documents/survey.ply. The resulting file must contain the same 600 points as the source data, with no points removed or altered.
task_grounding: Open the ASCII point cloud /home/user/Documents/survey.xyz in CloudCompare. It contains 600 points in X Y Z format. Use File > Save As to export it as a binary little-endian PLY at /home/user/Documents/survey.ply. When the PLY export dialog prompts for an encoding, pick the binary little-endian option. Do not drop any points.

cli_feasibility.translation: Use CloudCompare CLI: cli-anything-cloudcompare export cloud INDEX output.ply --preset ply [--overwrite]
cli_feasibility.reason: CLI has 'export cloud' command supporting multiple formats (PLY binary/ASCII, LAS, XYZ, etc.) with format-specific options.
